item.title: Having paid $11M to voice creators to date, ElevenLabs launches Music Marketplace to let its users monetize their AI-generated tracks - Music Business Worldwide
item.description: ElevenLabs says that 14m+ ‘studio-grade tracks have been created’ since the launch of its Eleven Music AI music generator last year…

item.title: Deezer launches revamped ‘Deezer for Business’ platform, bringing partnerships, advertising, AI detection licensing and more under one roof - Music Business Worldwide
item.description: Move comes days after the French streamer reported its first-ever annual profit.

item.title: Mandopop superstar Jay Chou is about to release his new album ‘Children of the Sun’ via UMG, led by a $2.8M music video. The timing couldn’t be more significant. - Music Business Worldwide
item.description: The album is also the first new studio record released since Chou and his label JVR Music signed a strategic global partnership with Universal Music Greater China in December 2023…

item.title: Live Nation invests in Romania’s Emagic and Slovakia’s Vivien as it expands Central and Eastern European footprint - Music Business Worldwide
item.description: Live Nation says it is ‘strengthening the foundations’ of live music in the region.

item.title: France’s recorded music revenues hit $1.21B in 2025, up 3.9% YoY; subscription streaming revenues grew 5.9% YoY - Music Business Worldwide
item.description: The figures mark a tenth consecutive year of growth for the world’s sixth-largest recorded music market.
